questions.question: Why is 担仔面 also called 度小月担仔面?

choices.text: It was created by a person named Xiao Yue
It was a celebration food that people ate during the small months
It was a dish that fisherman carried on poles to sell during the small months
choices.explanation: 担仔面 (Danzai noodles) are noodles in a pork and shrimp-head broth, topped with shrimp, minced pork, egg and bean sprouts. They are also known as 度小月担仔面, which translates to “noodles on a carrying pole to get through the small months”. Months with frequent typhoons are called “小月” (small months). During these months it was hard to go out to sea, so fishermen carried noodles on poles and sold them for a living. The noodles helped them get through the small months, which gave 度小月担仔面 its name.

choices.text: It originated from a ferry crossing called Xiao Yue

questions.question: Which of the following means allergy?

choices.text: A Taiwanese dumpling made of starch and rice flour, filled with meat and vegetables
choices.explanation: 肉圆 (bah-oân) is a translucent dumpling made of sweet potato starch and rice flour, filled with pork, bamboo shoots and mushrooms. It is steamed or deep-fried and served with a sweet and savory sauce.

choices.text: A dish that fisherman carried on poles to sell during the small months
choices.explanation: This describes 担仔面 (Danzai noodles) from the first question, not 肉圆.

choices.text: A Taiwanese meat ball that is served in a meat and vegetable broth
choices.explanation: This describes pork ball soup (贡丸汤), not 肉圆.

choices.text: A Taiwanese dumpling made from wheat flour, filled with meat and vegetables
choices.explanation: 肉圆 is not made from wheat flour. Its chewy, translucent skin comes from starch and rice flour.
